name: floating price tag
author: WeDevlops

sections.description:
The Floating Price Tag Animation plugin for WordPress adds an animated effect of a Floating Price Tag with different colors to your website.  It is a visually engaging extension designed to display animated price tags that float upward across the entire screen

Dynamic Visuals: This plugin adds an animated effect of Floating Price Tag Animation to your WordPress website, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

Responsive Design: The animation works seamlessly across all devices, ensuring a consistent visual experience on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

Versatile Use: Perfect for adding a magical touch to your site, celebrating special events, or simply making your website more engaging.

Compatibility: Fully tested and operational on WordPress version 6.x and works with all WordPress templates.

Easy Setup: Quick to install and configure, enabling you to add the Floating Price Tag Animation effect to your site with minimal effort.

This module is perfect for adding a whimsical and dynamic effect to your WordPress site. By the animation, you can create a unique and captivating price tag field that enhances the overall user experience and keeps visitors engaged.

FOR PRO VERSION:

Customizable Animation: You can control the speed of the Price tag animation and the delay between each price tag’s appearance through the WordPress admin panel. This allows you to create unique and captivating stars

Random Color Generation: Each Price tag is assigned a random color, creating a vibrant and lively display that captures visitors’ attention.

Customizable Colors: Simply add the colors you want to show in the backend settings and customize your text display on the price tag.

Easy Setup: With backend settings for Price Tag Animation Colors, Price Tag Animation Speed, Price Tag Floating Text, and Price Tag Appearance Delay. (see screenshot below for admin settings)

CLICK HERE FOR THE LIVE DEMO – https://wp.wedevlops.com/floating-price-tag-for-wordpress/
